# PRD – Product Detail Page (PDP)

*Source of truth: Zimmermann Functional Requirements.xlsx, sheets "Product, Catalogue and PDP" (PRD), "Cart & Inventory" (CAI), "Payments" (PAY), "Returns and Refunds" (RRC), "Customers, Account, CRM Sync" (CRM), "Order Management" (OM). Last updated: 2026-06-19.*

---

## 1. Page Structure

- Breadcrumb navigation displayed on all PDP pages (PRD-001, confirmed)
- Style code (SKU) displayed on PDP (PRD-007, confirmed)
- Key supporting information in expandable accordions: **Details, Size & Fit, Care, Shipping & Free Returns** (region-specific content) (PRD-008, confirmed)

---

## 2. Product Data

- Product name, price, sizes, and colour swatches sourced from the **Product API** (fed from AP21, but AP21 may not be the sole source in future — do not hard-code AP21 as the only data provider). Colour swatch assets do not live in AP21 — only colour names (PRD-002, confirmed — requirement updated for clarity 05.05)
- Style code (SKU) from product data (PRD-007, confirmed)
- "Also available in" / "Only available in" colour swatches; selecting a colour updates the page content and URL (PRD-004, confirmed). Hover-to-preview swatch behaviour (colour updates on rollover without click) is a **custom build, not OOTB, and not scoped for go-live** — see Open Items (PRD-004)
- *Open: product copy ownership (description, editorial text) — Contentful vs SFCC vs AP21 is TBD (see AGENTS.md "Unresolved Dependencies")*

---

## 3. Product Badges & Tags (PRD-005 – PRD-006, confirmed)

- Products can carry one or more badges: **Campaign, Runway, Exclusive, Online Exclusive, VIC Exclusive** — badge *assignment* on applicable products is confirmed (PRD-005)
- Multiple badges per product are supported; a defined display priority/hierarchy applies when more than one badge is present
- Badge creation must not require a code deployment (PRD-005, comment: "ideally the creation of these badges would not require a code change")
- **Badges are clickable** and navigate the customer to a PLP view filtered to products in that badge category (PRD-005, confirmed — workbook updated 2026-06-19: "captured in requirement"). See also plp.md §2.6.
- *Design caveat: badges not yet present in PLP designs ("Missing badges in PLP") (PRD-005)*

---

## 4. Product States (PRD-010 – PRD-017, confirmed)

- **Coming Soon** — product is displayed on PDP before stock is added or purchase is enabled
- **Back in Soon** — product has sold out but will restock imminently (re-cut)
- **Unavailable (size-level)** — triggers the Notify Me flow for the affected size variant
- OOS sizes visually greyed out/disabled; Add to Bag is suppressed for that size variant (PRD-014)
- All product states (Coming Soon, Back in Soon, Unavailable) must comply with **Google Merchant Centre** feed rules — ineligible-state products must not surface in product feeds (PRD-017)
- Low-stock indicator at size level: displays **"LOW"** label — purely visual, does not alter CTA behaviour or block add-to-bag (PRD-012; also PRD-030 from CAI)

---

## 5. Pricing Display

- Display price in storefront currency (AUD, USD, GBP, EUR)
- Sale pricing: was/now format (PRD-003, confirmed — subject to designs). If price changes again after being put on sale, only "now" updates; "was" is retained (REG-042, confirmed)
- Tax label per storefront: GST (AU), VAT (UK/EU), Tax (US) (PAY, confirmed)
- **Duties and taxes information** displayed country-specifically on PDP (PRD-013, confirmed)
- **DDP/DDU messaging** displayed on PDP per applicable countries (PAY-059, confirmed)
- Max configurable purchase quantity enforced per customer group (PRD-011, confirmed)
- *Open: HK/ME/US Intl/EU Intl pricing display — Global-e pricing via SFCC price books is defined and REG-041 is confirmed (REG-040 retired). Sign-off of the full mechanism (PRC-34..PRC-43) is still pending; do not implement until confirmed.*

---

## 6. Availability & Add to Bag

*Buffer stock rules apply on PDP. See [cart.md](cart.md) section 5 for the full buffer stock system.*

- Per-size availability shown (ADD TO BAG / OUT OF STOCK / low-stock "LOW" indicator)
- **ADD TO BAG** shown when quantity is above buffer threshold
- **OUT OF STOCK** shown when quantity is at or below buffer threshold (back-in-stock capture presented)
- Low-stock indicator at size level — no quantity number shown — displays "LOW" label
- **Max 3 units per SKU** (same size + colour) enforced at add-to-cart (CAI-017, confirmed)
- **No soft reservation** at add-to-cart (CAI-032, confirmed)

---

## 7. Primary CTAs & Supporting Links (PRD-018 – PRD-022, confirmed)

- **Add to Bag** — primary CTA when in stock
- **Find in Boutique** — opens as a **slide-out** (not a modal) alongside Add to Bag (PRD-018)
- **Wishlist icon** — displayed alongside the primary CTA; size must be selected before wishlist save (PRD-019, PRD-020)
- Supporting links: **Unavailable** (opens slide-out notify me form), **Find My Size**, **Size Guide** (PRD-021)
- **Need Assistance** section: links to email, live chat (with availability hours caveat), and Contact Us (PRD-022). The "Contact Us" link is an external redirect to the Zendesk-hosted contact form — there is no embedded Zendesk integration in the storefront.

---

## 8. Find in Boutique (CAI-037 – CAI-042, PRD-028 – PRD-039)

The "Find in Boutique" CTA is shown on all eligible products. The feature opens as a **flyout/slide-out panel** (not a modal). All Find in Boutique requirements are now **confirmed** but carry a **Phase 2** design caveat (design not yet available — "Phase 2").

### Panel contents
- "Find in Boutique" CTA only displays for products where in-store stock checking is supported (PRD-028, confirmed — Phase 2 design)
- At top of panel: product thumbnail, product name, selected colour, and price (PRD-029, confirmed — Phase 2 design)
- **Size selector** pre-populated from the PDP selection; customer can change size within the panel (PRD-030, confirmed — Phase 2 design)
- A **real-time inventory call** to NewStore via MuleSoft is made once a size is selected; the call refreshes when the customer selects a different size (CAI-038)
- **No auto-refresh** while the panel is open; boutique stock cached with configurable TTL (CAI-042)
- **Location search field** to filter boutique results (PRD-031, confirmed — Phase 2 design)
- **"Use My Location"** option triggers browser geolocation with explicit permission; handles failure case gracefully with inline message (PRD-032, PRD-033, confirmed — Phase 2 design)
- **Maps integration** via Google Maps (via MRT API connection) for boutique directions (PRD-034, confirmed — Phase 2 design)
- Per-boutique results show: name, address, distance (if geolocation permitted), stock status (**In Stock / Low Stock – Contact Boutique to Confirm Availability / Out of Stock**), opening hours, contact details, current live open status (e.g. "OPEN – CLOSES AT 6:00PM"), map pin, and a view more button (PRD-035, confirmed). Opening hours and live open status are sourced from the **Google Business API** (with a manual override available in Business Manager) — distinct from the Google Maps integration used for the map pin and directions (TPI: Google Business API; Google Maps).
- **Get Directions** link per boutique result, opening the location in a maps application (PRD-036, confirmed)
- Configurable limit on number of boutique results displayed (PRD-039, confirmed)
- Display a clear message when no boutiques carry the selected size (CAI-041)
- **No buffer stock** applied to boutique inventory (CAI-040)
- Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile (PRD-037, confirmed)
- Enter key triggers search in the location field (PRD-038, confirmed)

---

## 9. Back-in-Stock Notifications / Stock Alert (OM-033 – OM-034, PRD-040 – PRD-049, confirmed)

Shown when product/size is OOS (Unavailable state):

- Stock alert CTA/link displayed on PDP when selected size is OOS (PRD-040)
- Opens as a slide-out with the stock alert sign-up form: product name, price, and product image thumbnail at top (PRD-041, PRD-042)
- **Multiple size selection supported** — customer selects which unavailable sizes to register for (PRD-043)
- Customer name and email captured as required fields; **pre-populated and editable for authenticated customers** (PRD-044)
- **Marketing opt-in/out checkbox** compliant with regional consent requirements, gated by Omneo consent management (PRD-045)
- Clear submission CTA to register the stock alert (PRD-046)
- Confirmation message shown within the slide-out on successful submission (PRD-047)
- Notifications sent **FIFO** to first configurable-N (default 30) customers when stock returns above buffer; if stock is still available after a configurable time window (default 30 minutes), the next batch of 30 receives the email (PRD-048)
- Stock replenishment signal flows from NewStore → MuleSoft → SFCC → email trigger (PRD-049)
- No loyalty tier prioritisation

---

## 10. Find My Size / Measmerize (PRD-050 – PRD-053)

The Measmerize widget is embedded on PDP and manages the Find My Size experience:

- Once Measmerize generates a recommendation, the system updates the CTA to display **"Recommended: Size X"** (PRD-050 — Measmerize widget manages behaviour)
- When the customer clicks "Recommended", the Measmerize widget handles navigation to the recommendation view — SFCC does not control this flow (PRD-051 removed as not applicable for SFCC)
- Whether the "Find My Size" link is shown/suppressed based on Measmerize data availability is managed by the Measmerize widget, not SFCC (PRD-052 removed as not applicable for SFCC)

---

## 11. Size Guide (PRD-053 – PRD-057, confirmed)

- Size guide opens as a **slide-out overlay** (not a modal) without navigating away from the PDP (PRD-053, confirmed)
- Size guide content is delivered via the **Measmerize overlay** (confirmed — VR/RT comment resolved 2026-06-19: "Yes is going to be a measmerize overlay"). The Contentful-managed size guide is shown as a fallback only where no Measmerize data exists for a given product.
- *SEO/LLM risk (acknowledged, not blocking): Measmerize is a third-party overlay; content rendered within it may not be indexable by search engines or LLMs. The decision to use Measmerize is made; this risk is noted for the team to monitor.*
- Size conversion tables appropriate to the selected product type (PRD-054)
- Size guide content managed as a **structured Contentful content type** per product type (Ready to Wear, Swim, Accessories, Belts, Jewellery, Men's, Denim, Hats, etc.) (PRD-055)
- **Measurement toggle: cm / inches** (PRD-056)
- Size guide content manageable without a code deployment — content managed via CMS (PRD-057, confirmed 2026-05-25)

---

## 12. EU Environmental Qualities / AGEC (PRD-009, confirmed)

- Environmental Qualities accordion rendered on EU storefronts (`/en-eu/`, `/fr-eu/`) only
- Data sourced from AP21
- **Only renders when data exists** — no placeholder or empty accordion shown

---

## 13. Content Modules

### As Seen / Seen on the Runway editorial module (PRD-023, confirmed)
- CMS-managed editorial imagery module per product or collection (per new designs, surfaced as "Seen on the Runway"). Confirmed subject to designs.

### Shop the Look (PRD-024, confirmed)
- "Shop the Look" module displayed on PDP; clicking a product navigates to its PDP
- Auto-hides if no related products are populated; excludes out-of-stock products

### Styling module (PRD-025, confirmed — requirement updated 06.05)
- Styling is part of the Shop the Look module (same thing) — treat as a Shop the Look variant, not a separate module.
- Applies to **dresses and jewellery**; must auto-hide if related content/products are not populated; must **not** display for kids, men's, or other accessories.

### You May Also Like (PRD-026, SPR-58, confirmed)
- "You May Also Like" carousel powered by SFCC Einstein; rules-based fallback at launch
- Note: design refers to this as "More Colourful x" — implement per final designs

### Recently Viewed (PRD-027, SPR-61, confirmed)
- "Recently Viewed" carousel / "See Full History"/"See All" button (design TBC) based on browsing session
- Session-based for guests; persists cross-session for logged-in customers

---

## 14. Product Imagery & Media (PRD-058 – PRD-070)

- Multiple images per product: front, back, detail, and model shots (PRD-058, confirmed)
- Thumbnail gallery navigation (PRD-059, confirmed)
- **Hover-to-zoom or click-to-expand lightbox** on primary image — desktop (PRD-060, confirmed)
- **Pinch-to-zoom and swipe-to-advance** gallery navigation — mobile and touch (PRD-061, confirmed)
- Gallery updates to display variant images when a colour swatch is selected, without a full page reload (PRD-062, confirmed)
- Images served in optimised format at appropriate resolutions per device breakpoint (PRD-063, confirmed)
- Primary hero image **priority-loaded** (may vary per product — flatlay, model, or video) (PRD-064, confirmed)
- Consistent image aspect ratio across all products (PRD-065, ready for sign off)
- Optional **video content** (runway, model movement) as a tile in the image gallery; plays inline or expands to lightbox; multiple videos supported (e.g. studio, campaign, runway) (PRD-066, ready for sign off)
- Video autoplay configurable per video instance without a code deployment (PRD-068, ready for sign off)
- Flexible image presentation per page type (configurable background colour/treatment) without asset duplication (PRD-069, ready for sign off)
- Alt text required on all product images before a product can be published (PRD-070, ready for sign off)
- *Open: Video hosting platform — Vimeo is under consideration but not confirmed. Action open to confirm the best solution for smoothest FE experience (PRD-067). Note: the Third Party Integrations sheet lists Vimeo as the media platform (embed URL stored in product data or CMS); this conflicts with PRD-067's challenging comment ("Vimeo has not been 100% confirmed") — treat as Open until the open action resolves.*

---

## 15. Non-Returnable / Final Sale Indicator (RRC-003, confirmed)

- Non-returnable / final sale indicator displayed on PDP for applicable products
- Applies to: gift cards, final sale items, and any SKU flagged non-returnable at SKU level
- Message copy is configurable

---

- **Unavailable (size-level)** — triggers the Notify Me flow for the affected size variant

# PRD – Homepage, Layout & Content

*Source of truth: Zimmermann Functional Requirements.xlsx, sheets "Homepage and Content" (HPC) and "Storefront Templates". Last updated: 2026-06-25.*

*Note: Most HPC rows are marked **Confirmed** (signed off 2026-05-06 by Dani; secondary Emma, Rebecca). Rows with no primary sign-off and/or a challenging comment are routed to Open Items, not documented as confirmed behaviour.*

### Template delivery scope (Storefront Templates sheet)
The system delivers page templates for the homepage, global navigation, footer, and country/language selector. (Catalogue, cart/checkout, account, content/static, and SEO-migration templates are covered in their own PRDs.)

---

## 1. Global Header (HPC-015 – HPC-028)

- **Sticky** on scroll, all pages and devices (HPC-015, confirmed). Mobile unsticky-on-scroll behaviour (header reappears on scroll-up, à la Jacquemus) is a **new design requirement pending design prototype** — do not implement until the prototype is delivered.
- Brand logo links to homepage (HPC-016, confirmed). **Three logo behaviour scenarios flagged** — to be defined per designs before implementation.
- **Rotating promotional announcement banner** above the header — CMS-managed via Contentful (HPC-017, confirmed).

### Header icons (HPC-018 — Confirmed)
The confirmed header icon set is: **Search, Account, and Bag** (HPC-018). Locate Boutique, Contact Us, and Newsletter are **not part of the header** — confirmed per design review on 23 June 2026. Placement of those three icons elsewhere (footer or other location) remains design-dependent and will follow the new UX designs.

- **Wishlist icon**: anonymous → redirects to login (HPC-019, confirmed — guest wishlist explicitly **not in scope for launch** per 25/05 review; logged to enhancement log); logged-in → wishlist page (HPC-020, confirmed)
- **Bag icon**: displays running item count (HPC-021, confirmed)
- **Country/region selector**: visible in header on all storefronts **except AU** (HPC-026, confirmed — AU is the default/x-default storefront and has no selector). The selector also appears in the **footer**, in addition to the header (HPC-026, confirmed). On mobile it is additionally surfaced within the **hamburger/burger menu** (HPC-025, confirmed). No international pages exist yet (HPC-026 design note). See [regional.md](regional.md) for selector behaviour.
- Region selection persists across sessions (HPC-027, confirmed)
- Business users can add/remove navigation items without a code change (HPC-028, confirmed)

### Open Items (header)
- **Mobile unstick-on-scroll** (HPC-015) — new design requirement (Jacquemus-style reappear-on-scroll-up); pending design prototype. Base sticky behaviour confirmed; designs currently do not show the header as sticky.
- **Logo behaviour** (HPC-016) — 3 logo behaviour scenarios flagged, to be defined per designs.

---

## 2. Navigation (HPC-022 – HPC-025, HPC-029)

- Top-level categories link to PLP (HPC-022, confirmed — design dependency: each top-level item is either a mega menu trigger or a direct page link)
- **"Back in Boutique"** is a manually curated navigation category routing to its own PLP (HPC-023, confirmed)
- **Desktop**: mega menu on hover — with the exception of **Z.Immerse**, which functions as a direct link to a page, not a mega menu trigger (HPC-024, confirmed)
- **Mobile**: hamburger menu (HPC-025, confirmed). The country/region selector is also surfaced within the mobile hamburger/burger menu (HPC-025, confirmed — placement detail). Selector scope is all storefronts except AU (HPC-026).
- The system supports **cloning of the global navigation structure across markets** (HPC-029, confirmed)

---

## 3. Homepage Content (HPC-001 – HPC-012)

- Contentful is the sole CMS across all regional storefronts (HPC-001, confirmed). Integration is via the Salesforce App Exchange connector, consuming content through the Contentful delivery API for all customer-facing pages (Third Party Integrations — CMS / Contentful). Homepage carries product names only, which sit in Contentful.
- All images and video assets managed through the **Contentful media library** (HPC-003, confirmed)
- Video referenced via **embed URL** within CMS content entries (HPC-004, confirmed). Vimeo video is supported on editorial pages via URL embed, with the embed URL stored in the CMS (Third Party Integrations — Media / Vimeo)
- Locale-specific homepage content across all regional storefronts (HPC-005, confirmed)
- Regional authors can publish locale-specific content without affecting other storefronts (HPC-007, confirmed)
- **Full-width hero banner** with CMS-managed imagery, copy and CTA links; supports full bleed or padded, square or portrait (HPC-008, confirmed)
- **Editorial modules**: campaign imagery, collection features, product spotlights (HPC-009, confirmed)
- Global/local content model: some content global (e.g. Sustainability, Fashion Show Hub), some localised (e.g. policy pages). Homepage is rarely global (HPC-011, confirmed)

### Graceful degradation
If Contentful content fails to load, render the page without editorial content — never block on a CMS response. See AGENTS.md Graceful Degradation.

### Open Items
- **Contentful vs SFCC scope split** (HPC-001, HPC-002, HPC-006, HPC-010, HPC-012) — pending discussion with Contentful. Affects whether product names/prices sit in Contentful or SFCC ("EK - If we are displaying Product names and Potentially prices this would sit on SFCC").
- **Contentful preview environment** (HPC-002) — no primary sign-off; challenged: "EK - As we have a Contentful Studio license - is this required?" Studio licence may make a separate preview environment redundant.
- **Media library download allowance** (HPC-003) — open action on Zimmermann to confirm 12,000 GB/month is sufficient for peak trade; licence may need revising.
- **Transperfect translation workflow** (HPC-006) — no primary sign-off; challenged: "EK - We need to discuss the translation strategy/workflow." Preference: translation memory/workflow in the CMS with a Transperfect integration for human review. Full workflow to be agreed.
- **Reusable page builder templates** (HPC-010) — no primary sign-off; challenged: "is this required? DR: The ability to reuse an existing template is needed... Is this possible within Studio?" Feasibility within Contentful Studio pending.
- **Live stream embedding via structured CMS solution** (HPC-012) — no primary sign-off; pending Contentful vs SFCC scope split.

---

## 4. Didomi Consent Notice (HPC-013 – HPC-014, confirmed)

- Didomi consent notice **greys out all site content** and prevents interaction with all site elements while displayed (HPC-013, confirmed — subject to designs)
- Grey-out is removed and full site interactivity restored once the customer has completed the consent flow (HPC-014, confirmed)
- Didomi and GTM must be integrated within the PWA Kit to support **Google Consent Mode v2** signal passing; third-party tracking and marketing scripts load only after consent is granted. Didomi configuration and tag-layer gating are out of scope for SFCC and remain with Zimmermann (Third Party Integrations — Consent and Privacy / Didomi)
- For per-storefront consent defaults and GTM integration, see [regional.md](regional.md) section 7

---

## 5. Global Footer (HPC-030 – HPC-033, HPC-038, confirmed)

- Global footer with content managed via Contentful, editable per website or locale (HPC-030, confirmed)
- Footer navigation links (HPC-031, confirmed) navigate to the relevant page or destination on click (HPC-032, confirmed)
- Copyright and legal text in the footer (HPC-033, confirmed)
- Business users can add region-specific footer links — e.g. Acknowledgement of Country on AU storefront (HPC-038, confirmed)
- **Country/region selector** also appears in the footer (in addition to the header), on all storefronts except AU (HPC-026, confirmed). See section 1 and [regional.md](regional.md).

---

## 6. "Join Us" Email Capture (HPC-034 – HPC-037, confirmed)

- "Join Us" email capture field in the footer (HPC-034, confirmed)
- On clicking the Continue CTA, a **modal** collects the customer's **first name and last name** (HPC-035, confirmed)
- Sign-up data passed to **Omneo**, which then forwards to **Emarsys** (HPC-036, confirmed)
- Sign-up modal displays appropriate privacy consent copy, a link to the local Privacy Policy, **and an accessibility disclaimer** (HPC-037, confirmed)
- Guest capture timing subject to the Omneo guest record creation open item (see AGENTS.md "Unresolved Dependencies")

---

## 7. Inside Chat (HPC-039 – HPC-040, confirmed)

- Chat widget displayed as a pop-up overlay on relevant pages; page visibility rules determined by Inside Chat (HPC-039, confirmed)
- The widget loads **via GTM script injection through the Addingwell container** — not a direct PWA script include. Inside Chat configuration and routing logic sit outside SFCC and remain with Zimmermann (Third Party Integrations — Live Chat / Inside Chat)
- Chat widget must only be initialised **after Didomi consent** for the relevant cookie category (HPC-040, confirmed)
- See [regional.md](regional.md) section 7
